context: Two friends gossip at the cafe about a celebrity comparison
purpose: Teach: メイク/ストップ/不自由/無知/文字通り/はぁ/比べれ/尋ねる

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、聞いた？昨日の番組で、あの女優さんが文字通り号泣してたの。
lines.en: Hey, did you hear? On yesterday's show, that actress was literally sobbing her eyes out.
lines.style: Casual gossipy tone, leaning in with conspiratorial excitement between close friends.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー、見逃した！他人と比べればそりゃ落ち込むよね、毎回比較されて。
lines.en: Aww, I missed it! Compared with others, of course she'd get down—she's compared every time.
lines.style: Soft sympathetic delivery, dreamy and emotionally invested in the celebrity drama.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そう！司会者がわざわざ尋ねるのよ、ライバルの女優さんについて。
lines.en: Exactly! The host went out of his way to ask her about her rival actress.
lines.style: Animated storytelling voice, mimicking the host with slight theatrical flair and disbelief.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うわ、ストップって感じ。そういう質問って失礼じゃない？
lines.en: Ugh, that's like, just stop. Isn't that kind of question rude?
lines.style: Mildly indignant but gentle, raising eyebrows with sympathetic concern for the star.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ほんとそれ。しかもナチュラルメイクなのに、すごく綺麗で、隣の人が霞んじゃってた。
lines.en: Right? And even with just natural makeup, she was so pretty that the person next to her faded away.
lines.style: Impressed and slightly envious tone, gesturing with hands to emphasize the comparison.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: はぁ、羨ましい。私だったら言葉に不自由するくらい緊張しちゃうよ、あんな場で。
lines.en: Sigh, so jealous. If it were me, I'd get so tongue-tied I couldn't speak in a setting like that.
lines.style: Dreamy wistful sigh, hand resting on cheek with romantic melancholy and envy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あはは、メイは大丈夫だって。でもネットの反応がひどくて、無知なコメントばっかりだったらしいよ。
lines.en: Haha, Mei, you'd be fine. But apparently the online reactions were awful, full of ignorant comments.
lines.style: Warm reassuring laugh shifting into disapproving headshake about strangers online.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: やだ、可哀想。やっぱり有名人って大変だね、心から応援したくなっちゃう。
lines.en: Oh no, poor thing. Celebrities really do have it tough, it makes me want to cheer her on from the heart.
lines.style: Genuinely sympathetic and tender, voice softening with romantic compassion for the star.
